name: Sofa Yolo - 3+2 Seater Sofa Set (Fabric, Sesame Grey)
description: Ergonomically designed to fit into any home and for any person, Sofa Yolo is engineered for luxury and comfort. This is a sofa that will leave you feeling blissful. Your living room will never be the same with this contemporary sofa as its centrepiece. With precise lines and tufted cushions, it adds just the right amount of charm and coziness. From its curved, mid-length armrests to sleek tapered legs, this sofa is modern and minimalist without being boring. The Sleepyhead Yolo sofa is made with premium-quality polyester fabric and is resistant to sagging and pilling. This provides a smooth texture for this piece as well as cozy cushioning for plush seating bringing stunning style and outstanding durability to your home. It has Wooden Finish legs and a sturdy frame that make it all the more durable. Sofa YOLO is extra cozy and comfortable owing to the cushioning of the sofa that consists of 3 layers – HR foam, a supersoft layer and outer padding – for an unparalleled and long-lasting level of comfort. The contemporary look screams expensive, and the tufting is buttonless so that it won't poke you in weird places. This adds an extra dash of comfort to the piece. It comes in different options like single-seater, two-seater & three-seater. It also comes in four colour options: Sesame Grey, Berry Blue, Avocado Green and Coco Brown. With its simple yet functional structure, this will blend seamlessly with your decor while providing ample seating space in any room. Sofa Yolo has a relaxed, spacious and contemporary feel and is perfect for family and friends. You can also lounge more selfishly, enjoying all that this sofa has to offer.

contentSections.heading: FAQs
contentSections.text: FAQs 1. What is Sofa Yolo? Sofa Yolo is a tufted cushion sofa from Sleepyhead, upholstered in premium fabric, with a contemporary, straight‑build design that functions as a compact, space‑saving sofa for small living rooms or apartments. 2. What are its unique features? It features a solid‑wood frame, a contoured back and fixed tufted back for a modern look, 3‑layer cushioning– HR foam, a supersoft layer and outer padding – for an unparalleled and long-lasting level of comfort. The tufting is buttonless so that it won't make you uncomfortable while sitting. It is wrapped in 320 GSM polyester fabric that is is resistant to sagging and pilling.; the sofa is extra cozy and comfortable, Yolo is built for convenience; has optimal ground clearance for easy retrieval of toys and hassle-free cleaning. 3. Is professional installation/assembly included with Sofa Yolo? No; it's DIY (Do‑It‑Yourself)”, meaning you can easily assemble it yourself and no professional in‑home assembly is required. 4. What are the space requirements for Sofa Yolo? The 3‑seater Sofa Yolo measures 190.5 cm (length) × 90.5 cm (depth) × 89 cm (height), so you should plan for at least 191 cm of wall length, plus 10–20 cm clearance on each side and in front for easy movement and comfortable access. 5. What warranty comes with Sofa Yolo? Sofa Yolo carries a 3‑year conditional/ manufacturing warranty. 6. Can I try the Sofa Yolo before purchasing? You can try it at a nearby Sleepyhead store. (link) 7. Is the Sofa Yolo customizable (fabric, color, configuration)? The Sofa is not customizable, but is available in colors such as Sesame Grey, Berry Blue, Avocado Green, & Coco Brown. 8. What seating configurations are available for Sofa Yolo? Sofa Yolo comes in single‑seater, two‑seater, and three‑seater straight configurations, as well as 3+2 and 3‑seater L‑shape sofa sets (LHS/RHS and with/without ottoman) that can be arranged in larger living spaces. 9. How do I clean and maintain Sofa Yolo? Clean using a soft, dry or slightly damp cloth for dust and light spills; for stains, blot (do not rub) with a mild, non‑bleach detergent solution on a damp cloth, then wipe with a clean, dry cloth. The 320 GSM polyester fabric is durable and resists sagging, but you should avoid harsh chemicals, sharp objects, and prolonged direct sunlight to keep the color and structure intact.
